_what: E1 dark knight FINAL K (R-C9-127): narrowed base (rig 3), Mixamo Great Sword set, mace in the two-hand grip, painted + value-graded body, cape fitted to the back, eye glow, unarmed set; bind order matched to the body (e47). Scale 1.96 m. + the EYE OF RECKONING spin, EXTENDED ARM (R-C9-132, from the wwcr reference). + R-C9-141 (eor3): the helm-crown NOTCH removed -- the body's own head no longer pierces the helm crown.

clips.idle: great sword idle (4), upright, seam-blended loop

eye_variant.sprites: eye_sockets.json (Head-local; 0.07 m additive billboards, see wl_e1/film_rt/gear_stills.gd _eyes())

binding: pieces share the body joint-node order (e47); binding by bone name in gear.gd is still recommended
source_note: Mixamo animation is retargeted into wl_body.glb; the raw Mixamo FBX are not redistributed (wl_e1/mixamo is gitignored)

eor_spin.recipe: R-C9-132 extended arm: ONE frame of idle@1.0 with named edits (e52: elbow opening, interior capped at 166 deg; shoulder aim to az 90 deg = his right side, fists at 1.27 m; no solver), turned rigidly CCW about his vertical (e48): start 0.200 s (7 keys, accelerates to 1200 deg/s, turns 120 deg), loop 0.300 s (10 keys, 9 x 40 deg), closes exactly
eor_spin.reference: reincarnated-godot scripts/wwcr_whirlwind.gd: R_GRIP_SWEEP 0.8449 m, SWEEP_Y 1.20 m at H_STAND 1.85 -> scaled to his 1.96 m: grip radius 0.8951 m, sweep height 1.2714 m

measured.note: his arm is shorter than the reference rig's: the right fist is REACH-LIMITED at 0.804 m (90% of 0.895) with the elbow 2.7 deg short of straight; the fists sit 3 cm above the scaled sweep height

eor_spin.grip_slide: in the two spin clips ONLY, weapon_r carries a TRANSLATION track: the haft slid 0.20 m outward through his fists (e54), so the pommel clears his chest (without it the pommel sits 0.16 m from his axis, inside the torso). weapon_r's origin is then 0.20 m head-ward of the right fist in these clips; the head = weapon_r origin + its +Y, so the effect's tip read is unchanged in method
eor_spin.previous: final_k_eor's eor_spin_* (idle stance, mace near the body) is superseded by this set; final_k_eor is kept unchanged
eor_spin.moving: in place: the runtime moves him while channelling
eor_spin.weapon: weapon_r keyed on every spin key (rotation: haft through both fists, e12; translation: the slide, e54)
eor_spin.lint: 21 lint WARN 0 fails (the WARNs are final_k's own); 56 fidelity/grid/seam PASS (spins AUTHORED, loop seam 0.0 m); joint lint PASS 12/12 moves incl. both spins (elbow min 2.7 deg), negative control FAIL-as-designed

crown_tuck.cause: the BODY mesh's own head (char1, dark brown) pierced the helm piece's crown shell by up to ~12 mm in a crescent across the front of the dome just above the brow (thin bands down both sides); at the 52.95-deg play camera it sat above the real visor and read as a second eye slit. The helm's own geometry and texture carry no such mark.
crown_tuck.change: 3566 Head-weighted body vertices (y 1.810-1.958 m, mean Head weight 0.9984) pulled in along rays from the head centre to sit >= 4 mm under the helm shell (max 11.9 mm), relaxed over the 1-ring; POSITIONS ONLY -- clips, skin, UVs, normals, texture, the helm (eye slit emission), the eye sockets, the mace and every other piece byte-identical to eor2. Crown height unchanged (1.96 m).
crown_tuck.note_gear_off: with the helm OFF (the Barrow's base/armed/plates stacks) the bare body's crown is up to ~12 mm lower in that crescent; it sits under the helm in the full kit and in every JOIN-1 cell
